dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Remember, there's no need to rush. Push yourself too hard, and all that stress will give you nightmares.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: And nightmares will absolutely sap your energy!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: So, take it easy. If your body's telling you to rest, you need to listen. You can take a nap right here next to me, how about that?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It's a completely different feeling... fighting here.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It's so different from dealing with nightmares. It almost feels like... dancing in a dream or enjoying some kind of impromptu performance.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I suppose this is as good a place as any to get some combat experience. Once we're done here, we should go for a soak in the hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: If you think about it... Could this play be a part of a dream?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Fascinating... Dreams tend to exist on a binary — either dark or light, with notes of bitterness or joy... Yet, this dream defies my attempts to understand it.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: With you to guide me, I'm eager to venture further into this place and discover the colors at the heart of this dream.
